titleA.text: Prototype A — Skill Tree: Learn by Doing

n1.text:
MAIN UX DECISIONS

• One visual system for both: dark studio background, white pill for context, round outlined buttons and a white Home circle, echoing SmartTouch Gen2. White filled pill = the one primary action per screen.
• Every icon carries a text label; touch targets are 56–72 px; body text 18–22 px.
• Skill Tree is task-first ("What do you want to get done?") and shows exploration progress only, never certification. No points, streaks or badges.
• Practice shows one question at a time, always marks a 'Suggested' answer, never says 'wrong', and allows Skip / Back / Exit.
• Explain & Recover never diagnoses: it states the simulated context, lets the operator confirm or correct it, lists checks and leaves control with the operator. Nothing is sent or changed automatically.

n2.text:
ASSUMPTIONS (no info in references)

• Canvas 1280×800 (16:10, close to the reference display).
• Barlow font as a stand-in; real SmartTouch typeface not confirmed.
• Top bar layout (time · context pill · help · Home) inferred from screenshots.
• Function icons are generic line icons, NOT Valtra's icon set.
• Placement of headland functions in the simplified preview (A3 step 3) is invented for practice only.
• Skill categories and progress states are illustrative.

n3.text:
WHERE SIMULATED CONTENT APPEARS

• Yellow dashed chip = simulated data (task, machine status, field view, training feedback).
• Grey dashed chip / dashed box = placeholder waiting for verified documentation.
• A0 & B1: task, implement, status values.
• A2: example use case and diagram.
• A3: all questions and feedback ('Training · Simulation').
• B2: issue summary. B3: all three checks and 'Why?' texts. B4: documentation and support routes.

n4.text:
VERIFY BEFORE OPERATOR TESTING

• Real headland-sequence behaviour, setup and terminology (Valtra docs).
• The three troubleshooting checks in B3 and their reasons.
• Where the function actually lives in SmartTouch (A3 step 3).
• Correct support route (dealer / documentation) for B4 — no contacts invented.
• Wording of training feedback in A3 with a domain expert.
• Replace the headland scenario with the verified field incident.

n5.text:
HOW TO EDIT

• Headlines, labels, body text: double-click and retype on the artboard.
• Lists (practice questions, options, feedback, issue choices, checks, support options): edit the SCENARIO block at the top of the script in A3, B2, B3 and B4 (Code view).
• Swap scenario: change SCENARIO + the headlines in A2, A3, B1–B4.
• Links between screens are plain <a href="…dc.html">; press Play on any artboard to click through.
• Shared styles (colours, buttons, chips) live in the same <style> block in every artboard.
